_note: SRD 5.1 spells only. 'target': enemy | cone (target + 2 near it) | line (target + 3) | enemies | ally | allies | self. FF-simple targeting stands in for areas.

firebolt.name: Fire Bolt
firebolt.desc: Cantrip. Spell attack, 1d10 fire (2d10 at level 5).

light.name: Light
light.desc: Cantrip. Bright light for the fight. Things that hate light, hate it.

dancinglights.name: Dancing Lights
dancinglights.desc: Cantrip. Four little lights. The crews go quiet when he does this one.

burninghands.name: Burning Hands
burninghands.desc: A fan of flame: 3d6 fire to up to three foes, DEX save for half.

magicmissile.name: Magic Missile
magicmissile.desc: Three darts that never miss, 1d4+1 force each.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.desc: 5d8 hit points of creatures fall asleep, weakest first.

findfamiliar.name: Find Familiar
findfamiliar.desc: Ritual. He knows it. He hasn't dared.
findfamiliar.src: SRD 5.1; wiki/aurdin.md (familiar undecided until he does the ritual in story)

mageArmor.name: Mage Armor
mageArmor.desc: An unarmored ally: AC 13 + DEX until the next long rest.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.desc: A wave of force: 2d8 thunder to up to three foes, CON half.

scorchingray.name: Scorching Ray
scorchingray.desc: Three rays, each a spell attack for 2d6 fire.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.desc: 3d8 thunder to up to three foes, CON half.

web.name: Web
web.desc: Up to three foes: DEX save or restrained.

holdperson.name: Hold Person
holdperson.desc: A humanoid: WIS save or paralyzed. It saves again each turn.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: 8d6 fire to every foe, DEX half.

lightningbolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightningbolt.desc: 8d6 lightning down a line of up to four foes, DEX half.

bless.name: Bless
bless.desc: Up to three allies add 1d4 to attacks and saves.

curewounds.name: Cure Wounds
curewounds.desc: Heals 1d8 + CHA. (Not the fallen: they need a kit.)

heroism.name: Heroism
heroism.desc: Immune to fear; temporary HP each turn.

lesserrestoration.name: Lesser Restoration
lesserrestoration.src: SRD 5.1 (Oath of Devotion oath spell, 5th level)

aid.name: Aid
aid.desc: Up to three allies: +5 max and current HP until the next long rest.

smite.name: Divine Smite
smite.desc: Attack; on a hit spend a slot for +2d8 radiant (3d8 from a 2nd-level slot; +1d8 vs undead or fiends).
